decision: Original marks on one side detect a once-loaded ring before reaching an original ring knot. An ordinary count loses exactly two at arbitrarily large offsets with growing radius. Both fixed ordinary and fixed bond radii have all-age protection on the singly attached paths. The old far pair stays at bond distance nine and counts 45/46 knots at bond radius seven.
review: In-task independent proof and computational checks complete. Program referee pending.
sample: Designed physical sources, one per allowed physical loading and unordered mark set, one per actual knot and per oriented shortest path for the named pair. No weighting over all starts.

measured_objects.object: Ordinary same-side steps and shortest routes
measured_objects.population: Every completed layer of the funded one-ring path, doubled meetings and two-ring preparations with marks on one side of each donor
measured_objects.outcome: Every ordinary separation and shortest-route multiplicity agrees across loads.

measured_objects.object: Ordinary count before any original ring knot
measured_objects.population: Consecutive sets of two to four marks at offset 2k on sufficiently padded single-ring paths, k at least two
measured_objects.outcome: Quiet minus loaded equals two from age k+1 at radius 2k+3. All smaller radii agree.

measured_objects.population: Outer path of one once-loaded ring with the four end spares and the registered feedback law
measured_objects.outcome: Ordinary radius r has all-age protection past twice floor((r-1)/2). Bond radius r has all-age protection from offset 2r+9 and stabilizes by age r+1.

measured_objects.object: Minimum common bond on old path marks
measured_objects.population: Exterior old marks with up to four distinctions, offset at least four from the outermost donor; single-ring first-layer readings of every same-side arity
measured_objects.outcome: Every covered minimum agrees across loads. The far old pair has distance nine permanently. A between-attachment triple has first-layer common-bond sizes 14 or 16 at unchanged pair readings 5,7,3.

measured_objects.object: Knot count in the bond union about e8,e12
measured_objects.population: The original 17-knot background with one-spare five-ring, completed age three and bond radius seven
measured_objects.outcome: 45 quiet, 46 loaded. Neither ball contains an original ring knot. An independent anchored enumeration confirmed both.

measured_objects.object: Offset-six least detecting bond radius for one fixed close pair
measured_objects.population: The 32-mark background with seam b12, e18/e19 at layer four
measured_objects.outcome: All smaller radii agree and radius nine gives 52/53. The predicted first radius eleven missed.

measured_objects.object: Dependence on physical initial load and a second attachment
measured_objects.population: All 64 shared-only physical loadings of a doubled five-ring and full four-arm contrasts on two registered double spacings
measured_objects.outcome: Attachment activity determines the moving decrease; four-step double can give a bond-ball interaction of minus one.
